lines.en: I am wrapped in a brown ball of silk.

lines.zh: 风一来，我就在叶背摆荡。
lines.en: When the wind comes, I rock under the leaf.
I edge along the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 这壳是我自己吐出来的。
lines.en: I spun this casing myself.
The branch bows, then springs back.
I have turned myself around.
My silk brushes lightly over the leaf.
I shift slowly among the twigs.
I hang steadier than I did yesterday.

lines.zh: 一滴雨水打湿了我的壳。
lines.en: A drop of rain wets my casing.

lines.zh: 我朝背风的那面挪过去。
lines.en: I move toward the leeward side.
I sway back and forth in the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 鸟飞过时，风把我推歪了。
lines.en: A bird passed, and the wind tipped me.

lines.zh: 我一点一点爬到更高的枝上。
lines.en: I climb by degrees to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 我在叶底下找了个凹处。
lines.en: I found a hollow under the leaf.
I hang and wait for the wind to drop.
I am wrapped tight and perfectly still.
Something is quietly changing within.

lines.zh: 我数着落在壳上的雨点。
lines.en: I count the raindrops striking my casing.
Water beads hang on my fuzz.
I am waiting for a certain morning.
The bright patch under the trees slides away.

lines.zh: 叶子互相碰着，响个不停。
lines.en: Leaves knock together, never silent.
My silk has loosened a very little.
I adjust the position within.
The wood has fallen quiet.
A beetle crawls past the leaf stalk.

lines.zh: 我在这个枝节上很安心。
lines.en: I feel safe on this joint of the branch.

lines.zh: 你看出这团丝是什么了吗？
lines.en: Can you tell what this ball of silk is?
I am the cocoon of a male moth.
Do not squeeze; wings are growing inside.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you when you looked up.

lines.zh: 这片林子里的蛾都是我亲戚。
lines.en: The moths of this wood are all kin of mine.
This cocoon is soft; don't touch.
I must wait a few more days.
Do not put your hand on this twig.
I am not moving because I cannot.
You want to see me fly? You must wait.
A seam has split in the silk.

lines.zh: 我的丝团挂在叶下，荡得很慢。
lines.en: My silk bundle hangs under the leaf, swinging slowly.
The wings inside tremble once.
The silk wall caves in and I can only curl.
A layer of fuzz has fallen.
I nearly fell.
The silk wall has gone soft.
I barely held on.
There is a damp mark on the leaf.
I have not come apart.

lines.zh: 我封在丝里，吃不了你的叶子。
lines.en: I am sealed in silk; I cannot eat your leaf.
That thing is for caterpillars.

lines.zh: 我的茧是褐色的，挂在枝上。
lines.en: My brown cocoon hangs from a twig.
The silk is too thick for smells.
I cannot even open my mouth now.
I wait only for the moment I break out.
Even moving a little is an effort.
A quiet wood suits me better.
Two steps back and I will relax.
That smell is overpowering.
The twig shook and my whole ball swung.
You brushed my silk.
Some fuzz has come off.

lines.zh: 叶背的阴影里，我看不见你。
lines.en: In the shade under the leaf I cannot see you.
I sway twice and then stop.
The silk holds me firmly in place.
The leaf curves under me.
This twig is too thin for both of us.
I slowly still my swinging.
Walk away and the wind will settle me.
No female moth will emerge from me.

lines.zh: 等翅膀硬了，我得去找她。
lines.en: When my wings harden, I must go and find her.
Just keep watch over the tree.
The male moth's colors run darker.
Neither of us needs to hurry.
When the time comes, I will circle the lamps.
Do not let anyone break this branch.
This wood will remember me.
Warmer wind is the signal.
I may fly very far.
Wrapped in silk, I cannot reach it.
Did you drop that?
It is caught in the fork of the branch.
I checked it with my silk.
My silk is too soft to pinch it.
It slid onto the leaf below.

lines.zh: 舞毒蛾的茧，摸着是绒的。
lines.en: A gypsy moth cocoon feels like velvet.
That thing throws back the light.
I brace it under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我用丝勾了一下，没勾住。
lines.en: I hook at it with silk and miss.
The only thing I fix on is sunlight.
You are cutting off the light.
I cannot chase anything.
My wings are still soft.
My wings are not hard yet; do not rush.
Half a step aside is enough.
This twig is mine.
I am not afraid, and I will not hide.
I am waiting to break out.
Come nearer; I still will not move.
I watch where you mean to touch.
Your hand has stopped there.
When the light changes, I know.
I can see even through the silk.
If the twig breaks, I fall.
The spongy moth cocoon hangs under a leaf.
A few days more and it will be time.

lines.zh: 森林的茧里，我听着外面。
lines.en: In the forest cocoon, I listen outside.
The wind comes from your side.
Your shadow has stayed put.

lines.zh: 我这一团，只够挡一下光。
lines.en: This bundle of mine can only block a little light.
This cocoon has little strength.
You pull your hand away fast, and I hold together.
If you mean to squeeze me, I shrink first.
I fell and landed on the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 丝上一道新印子，是你的。
lines.en: A new mark on the silk, and it is yours.

lines.zh: 你碰得很轻，茧还是晃了。
lines.en: You touched lightly, and the cocoon still swayed.
I turned to the leaf's underside.
Your fingerprint is on my silk.
Just let go and it is fine.

lines.zh: 毛虫在森林里结出了我。
lines.en: The caterpillar spun me in this forest.

lines.zh: 叶背多了一团褐色的丝。
lines.en: There is one more brown silk ball under a leaf.
A brown bundle, hidden under the leaf.
Layer after layer of silk wrapped around me.
I hang here, very quiet.
The forest wind arrived first.
I have become this from a caterpillar.

lines.zh: 这是我最闲的一段日子。
lines.en: These are my idlest days.
The sun comes through and warms my casing.

lines.zh: 绒毛上沾着细小的水珠。
lines.en: Fine droplets cling to my fuzz.
The heat has yellowed my silk.

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下，壳磕裂了。
lines.en: I fell from the branch and cracked my casing.

lines.zh: 水浸透了丝，里面闷得慌。
lines.en: Water soaks the silk and I am stifled.
The blast flips the entire branch.
Something grazed my cocoon.
The growth inside has suddenly gone awry.

lines.zh: 我的茧挂在树皮上，很牢。
lines.en: My cocoon clings tight to the bark.
A white glare pierces my casing.

lines.zh: 我从枝上落下，一直往下掉。
lines.en: I fall from the branch and keep falling.
